items.text: Zay Flowers suffered a hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day heading into MRI/testing. Would have returned if playoff game. Left early after 5/150/1.
items.why: Sources say not serious; MRI upcoming.
items.implication: Monitor practice; possible Week 2 return vs NO, else handcuff/backup targets rise.
items.opportunity: High snap/slot share before exit creates short-term vacuum if out.

items.text: Malik Nabers is active for Week 1.
items.implication: Start with decoy risk; high upside if full role.
items.opportunity: Resolves murky pregame status; full routes/targets expected if no limitation.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play. Status impacts Travis Etienne projection.
items.implication: Etienne sees elevated carries/routes/opps as primary beneficiary.
items.opportunity: Kamara absence opens NO backfield for Etienne.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled out with wrist injury (fracture, several weeks).
items.why: Ruled out; fracture context from beat.
items.implication: Miss several weeks; Ravens WR depth thins (Flowers also dinged).
items.opportunity: Removes rookie from rotation; targets to Flowers/Andrews/others.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love is ACTIVE. Risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere; wouldn't activate if major injury worry (Cardinals caveat).
items.why: Active confirmation + preseason ankle; team belief in availability.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside; monitor snaps vs committee.
items.opportunity: Expected to play per prior reports; role expansion possible.

items.text: AJ Brown high ankle sprain: no surgery needed, sidelined 4-6 weeks (IR).
items.why: Schefter: no surgery, 4-6 weeks; Rapoport ~6 weeks.
items.implication: NE WR1 vacuum; Doubs/Hollins/Douglas elevate short-term.
items.opportunity: IR min 4 weeks; targets redistribute in Maye offense.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially active.
items.implication: Start as WR2/3; full role expected.
items.opportunity: Expected per ETR; targets with Williams/Burden.

items.text: After meniscus trim, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game and returns Week 2 vs LAC.
items.why: Team sources: realistic W2 return possible; monitor feel this week.
items.implication: Stash/hold; potential quick TE1 return boosts LV pass game.
items.opportunity: Short absence opens temp TE targets if delayed.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid finally over PCL; 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Allen dropbacks (69%). Moves needle when on field.
items.implication: TE1 upside locked in; start confidently ROS if sustained.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets in Bills offense confirmed.

items.text: Panthers RB: Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps vs Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks side work early week allegedly groin tweak.
items.why: Clear snap/route/opp hierarchy; Brooks limited by tweak.
items.implication: Hubbard lead back; Brooks handcuff with limited Week 1 role.

items.text: Jonathan Taylor even in loss: 48/54 snaps (89%), 20 routes/34 dropbacks (59%), 4 tgts 13% share, 23/24 RB opps (96%). Colts distrust backups.
items.why: Near-total RB opportunity share despite loss/historical struggles.
items.implication: Elite volume lock; start as RB1 regardless of game script.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way.
items.implication: Start/stream TE; Andrews competition but volume rising.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland. Want as much Bears offense as possible; preseason take unchanged despite Week 1 weirdness/Kmet/Raymond targets.
items.why: Preseason belief in CHI offense share holds; Week 1 noise.
items.implication: Trade/acquire low; TE upside with Williams.
items.opportunity: Target competition but long-term role intact.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks (from Packers w/ new OC Mannion) more real than not; preseason talk validated.
items.why: Preseason hype + Week 1 confirmation in PHI.
items.opportunity: Role expansion with new OC scheme.
